name: Lentils Stew
method: Place a large pot over high heat with the olive oil, onion, celery, carrots, green pepper and garlic. Fry for 20 minutes, until properly caramelised.
Add the bay leaves, stock cube, paprika, oregano and cumin, and fry for about 3 minutes, stirring every so often.
Add the tinned tomatoes and cook for about 5 minutes, until a thick paste has formed.
Pour in the vinegar, then add the potatoes and the lentils. Pour in the water and season with salt and pepper.
Boil hard for 10 minutes, then simmer on medium for a further 15, or until the lentils are soft.
Stir the parsley through in the last minute, and enjoy.
